cases.description: Headings in a block quote and in a list item are not sections (§5.3), so of `> ## Quill`, `## Quill`, `- ## Quill` and `## Quill` the second gives `quill` and the fourth `quill-1`; GitHub numbers the headings in containers too, and gave the two `quill-1` and `quill-4` in the captured document, which also held a heading inside `<details>` that is left out here.
